finding_key: packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts::new vim history routing (`routevimhistorytostore`) has no test at all
evidence: `routeVimHistoryToStore` is new code (packages/notes/src/view/editor.ts:27-60) that monkey-patches `CodeMirror.commands.undo/redo`, resolves the store from `noteStoreFacet`, and gates on `EditorView.editable` with a fall-through to `defaultVimHistory`. The full editor.test.ts supplied at this commit contains only Mod-z/Mod-Shift-z, read-only-unbound, store-routing and "switches the keybinding mode" tests — none enter vim mode and invoke `u`/`<C-r>` or `CodeMirror.commands.undo`, and the new frontend integration test (notes-undo-integration.test.ts) never touches vim either; since the function is brand new, no pre-existing test could cover it. So the claim is accurate: the routing, facet lookup, editable guard, and fall-through are entirely untested, and because CM history is now disabled a regression there would silently strip undo for vim users. I rate it minor rather than higher because it is a test-coverage gap, not a defect in shipped behavior (I could not run the suite, but the relevant test files were fully visible).
